subject: maths
question: Bhanu travels from City A to City B. If Bhanu drives his car at (1)/(3) rd of his normal speed, then he reaches City B 50 minutes late. Find the time (in minutes) that Bhanu would have taken to travel from City A to City B if he drove at his normal speed.
solution:
**Given:**

Reduced speed = 1 ÷ 3 of normal speed

Delay = 50 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Time ∝ 1 ÷ Speed

If speed becomes 1 ÷ n, then time becomes n times

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let normal time = t

⇒ Reduced speed time = 3t

⇒ Delay = 3t − t

⇒ 2t = 50

⇒ t = 50 ÷ 2

⇒ t = 25

**∴ The correct answer is 25.**
